title: fix: switch to nocodb-v2 endpoint for project_cards
body: ## Summary Switches the `fetchProjects` thunk from `/api/nocodb/project_cards` (v1, backed by `nocodb.yatrik.dev`) to `/api/nocodb-v2/project_cards` (v2, backed by `nocodb.yatrikpatel.com`). The v1 endpoint returns a 401 because the old NocoDB instance's API key is no longer valid. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/ac912ce6816b4c799b7044cdca62756c Requested by: @ytrkptl ---
